summary: No malicious behavior identified in diezyclutch-baileys@8.6.92
details: No static-rule matches or traced installer-harm behaviors were identified in this package version. The package name resembles the popular WhatsApp library 'baileys', which is worth noting for a human reviewer given the history of malicious forks in this ecosystem, but name similarity alone is not a threat and no code in this artifact was observed to exfiltrate installer data, execute remote payloads at install/import time, embed a backdoor, or perform silent-relay of caller-supplied data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
